approvalType: Internal implementation review; not new user visual approval.

reviewedBy.root: All nine native five-stage contact sheets, native pixel comparisons, and actual 30/60Hz sequence playback.
reviewedBy.geometry: Selected source drawings and actual source-coordinate traces; independent final right/right-down/up/down composite sheets.

result: Five distinguishable authored stages are registered for both eyes and speaking mouth in every fixed pose. No blocking foreground-hair junction, nose fragment, upper-lip jump, or reversed final eyelid trajectory was identified in the inspected contact sheets.
knownLimits: Five discrete painted eye and speaking-mouth states per pose; not a continuous mesh deformation model.
Neighboring stages have unequal visual spacing; source-traced geometry is not fabricated by interpolation.
Source portraits were generated with image_gen and registered using local crops, source-traced apertures, and fixed upper-lip translation.
Visible spacing between neighboring stages is unequal; some weak intermediate steps are deliberately retained as real paintings.
Minor color and line-weight variations remain between independently generated sources.
30/60Hz drawing is playback cadence, not 30/60 unique expression drawings or guaranteed presentation FPS.
